{
 "cells": [

   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Robust Linear Models"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:30.417875Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:30.417647Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:31.131222Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:31.129501Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:31.134711Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:31.133578Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.883348Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.881381Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation\n",
    "\n",
    "Load data:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.887527Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.886407Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.897010Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.895608Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "data = sm.datasets.stackloss.load()\n",
    "data.exog = sm.add_constant(data.exog)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Huber's T norm with the (default) median absolute deviation scaling"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.900217Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.899252Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.922149Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.920719Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "const       -41.026498\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.829384\n",
      "WATERTEMP     0.926066\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.127847\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "const        9.791899\n",
      "AIRFLOW      0.111005\n",
      "WATERTEMP    0.302930\n",
      "ACIDCONC     0.128650\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "                    Robust Linear Model Regression Results                    \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   No. Observations:                   21\n",
      "Model:                            RLM   Df Residuals:                       17\n",
      "Method:                          IRLS   Df Model:                            3\n",
      "Norm:                          HuberT                                         \n",
      "Scale Est.:                       mad                                         \n",
      "Cov Type:                          H1                                         \n",
      "Date:                Thu, 29 Oct 2026                                         \n",
      "Time:                        08:39:32                                         \n",
      "No. Iterations:                    19                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          z      P>|z|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "var_0        -41.0265      9.792     -4.190      0.000     -60.218     -21.835\n",
      "var_1          0.8294      0.111      7.472      0.000       0.612       1.047\n",
      "var_2          0.9261      0.303      3.057      0.002       0.332       1.520\n",
      "var_3         -0.1278      0.129     -0.994      0.320      -0.380       0.124\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "If the model instance has been used for another fit with different fit parameters, then the fit options might not be the correct ones anymore .\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "huber_t = sm.RLM(data.endog, data.exog, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT())\n",
    "hub_results = huber_t.fit()\n",
    "print(hub_results.params)\n",
    "print(hub_results.bse)\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    hub_results.summary(\n",
    "        yname=\"y\", xname=[f\"var_{i}\" for i in range(len(hub_results.params))]\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Huber's T norm with 'H2' covariance matrix"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.925366Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.924398Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.939349Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.937880Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "const       -41.026498\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.829384\n",
      "WATERTEMP     0.926066\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.127847\n",
      "dtype: float64\n",
      "const        9.089504\n",
      "AIRFLOW      0.119460\n",
      "WATERTEMP    0.322355\n",
      "ACIDCONC     0.117963\n",
      "dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "hub_results2 = huber_t.fit(cov=\"H2\")\n",
    "print(hub_results2.params)\n",
    "print(hub_results2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Andrew's Wave norm with Huber's Proposal 2 scaling and 'H3' covariance matrix"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.941488Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.941247Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.977401Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.975915Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Parameters:  const       -40.881796\n",
      "AIRFLOW       0.792761\n",
      "WATERTEMP     1.048576\n",
      "ACIDCONC     -0.133609\n",
      "dtype: float64\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "andrew_mod = sm.RLM(data.endog, data.exog, M=sm.robust.norms.AndrewWave())\n",
    "andrew_results = andrew_mod.fit(scale_est=sm.robust.scale.HuberScale(), cov=\"H3\")\n",
    "print(\"Parameters: \", andrew_results.params)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "See ``help(sm.RLM.fit)`` for more options and ``module sm.robust.scale`` for scale options\n",
    "\n",
    "## Comparing OLS and RLM\n",
    "\n",
    "Artificial data with outliers:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.979623Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.979383Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.986990Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.985551Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "sig = 0.3  # smaller error variance makes OLS<->RLM contrast bigger\n",
    "beta = [5, 0.5, -0.0]\n",
    "y_true2 = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y2 = y_true2 + sig * 1.0 * np.random.normal(size=nsample)\n",
    "y2[[39, 41, 43, 45, 48]] -= 5  # add some outliers (10% of nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Example 1: quadratic function with linear truth\n",
    "\n",
    "Note that the quadratic term in OLS regression will capture outlier effects. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.990262Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.989015Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.997918Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:32.996633Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 5.09004355  0.52203646 -0.01322834]\n",
      "[0.4252172  0.0656478  0.00580882]\n",
      "[ 4.7593351   5.02420062  5.28465852  5.54070882  5.79235151  6.03958659\n",
      "  6.28241405  6.52083391  6.75484616  6.9844508   7.20964783  7.43043725\n",
      "  7.64681906  7.85879327  8.06635986  8.26951884  8.46827021  8.66261398\n",
      "  8.85255013  9.03807868  9.21919961  9.39591294  9.56821866  9.73611676\n",
      "  9.89960726 10.05869015 10.21336543 10.3636331  10.50949316 10.65094561\n",
      " 10.78799045 10.92062768 11.0488573  11.17267932 11.29209372 11.40710051\n",
      " 11.5176997  11.62389127 11.72567524 11.82305159 11.91602034 12.00458148\n",
      " 12.088735   12.16848092 12.24381923 12.31474993 12.38127302 12.4433885\n",
      " 12.50109637 12.55439663]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res = sm.OLS(y2, X).fit()\n",
    "print(res.params)\n",
    "print(res.bse)\n",
    "print(res.predict())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Estimate RLM:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.000450Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.000131Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.015132Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.013745Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 5.01773834e+00  5.11848158e-01 -3.93242436e-03]\n",
      "[0.13711645 0.02116893 0.00187312]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "resrlm = sm.RLM(y2, X).fit()\n",
    "print(resrlm.params)\n",
    "print(resrlm.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Draw a plot to compare OLS estimates to the robust estimates:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.017439Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.017173Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.335292Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.334240Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x700806b02660>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1200x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))\n",
    "ax = fig.add_subplot(111)\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y2, \"o\", label=\"data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true2, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "pred_ols = res.get_prediction()\n",
    "iv_l = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_lower\"]\n",
    "iv_u = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_upper\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, res.fittedvalues, \"r-\", label=\"OLS\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_u, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_l, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, resrlm.fittedvalues, \"g.-\", label=\"RLM\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Example 2: linear function with linear truth\n",
    "\n",
    "Fit a new OLS model using only the linear term and the constant:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.337786Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.337538Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.343593Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.342542Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[5.62322656 0.38975308]\n",
      "[0.37010819 0.03189002]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "X2 = X[:, [0, 1]]\n",
    "res2 = sm.OLS(y2, X2).fit()\n",
    "print(res2.params)\n",
    "print(res2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Estimate RLM:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.346461Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.346207Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.359755Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.358228Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[5.14058875 0.47759861]\n",
      "[0.10593196 0.00912753]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "resrlm2 = sm.RLM(y2, X2).fit()\n",
    "print(resrlm2.params)\n",
    "print(resrlm2.bse)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Draw a plot to compare OLS estimates to the robust estimates:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.361874Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.361642Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.626888Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-29T08:39:33.625887Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 800x600 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "pred_ols = res2.get_prediction()\n",
    "iv_l = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_lower\"]\n",
    "iv_u = pred_ols.summary_frame()[\"obs_ci_upper\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y2, \"o\", label=\"data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true2, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, res2.fittedvalues, \"r-\", label=\"OLS\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_u, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, iv_l, \"r--\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, resrlm2.fittedvalues, \"g.-\", label=\"RLM\")\n",
    "legend = ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  }
 ],
